questions.stem: What happens during the S phase (synthesis phase) of interphase?

options.text: The cell divides into two daughter cells
The chromosomes are pulled apart to opposite poles
The cell grows and produces new proteins
The DNA is replicated so the cell has two copies of each chromosome

questions.explanation: During the S (synthesis) phase, the cell's DNA is replicated. Each chromosome is copied to form two identical sister chromatids joined at the centromere, doubling the amount of DNA in preparation for cell division.
